warnings.message: 2.7% of characters are not A/C/G/T (1674 gaps, 0 ambiguity or other codes).

Deep tree (median patristic distance 0.284) with 212 taxa: neutral simulations in this regime gave a false-positive rate near 36% at 100 taxa (PLAN.md §2); treat site calls as a ranking, not as calibrated p-values.
96 codons x 212 taxa: about < 1 s of model time on a laptop CPU (reference path).
